contributions.detail: exact - 6 rows sum to 1,610.24 = the schedule's own 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS' box AND the cover. THE ARITHMETIC GATE EARNED ITS KEEP HERE: the first full-page read had line 3 as 191.41, which left the side 0.20 short of its own printed total; a 1000 dpi crop of the amount column showed the cents are 61, not 41, and the corrected figure closes the side exactly. The mirrored expense row on p3 (Staples, 191.61) is the independent confirmation.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 ends in 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS  $1,610.24' and the 6 rows reproduce it to the cent, matching the cover. p3 ends in 'TOTAL EXPENSES  $1,249.02' and the 4 rows reproduce it to the cent, matching the cover. The two schedules also cross-gate each other: three of the six contributions (843.42, 200.21, 191.61) are the exact amounts of three of the four expenses, because the candidate and her family paid campaign bills directly and booked them as contributions - so each of those figures is stated twice in the document, on different pages, in different columns. 1,610.24 - 1,249.02 = 361.22 reproduces the cover's balance independently. No specimen rows exist on the 2026 form.

_meta_itemized.notes: Clean scan, legible hand, and the most informative REDACTION case in this chunk: the county's black bars are applied CELL BY CELL and PARTIALLY, not to the whole column. Lines 1, 2, 3 and 5 have their entire ADDRESS cell blacked out; lines 4 and 6 have only the street NUMBER blacked out, leaving the street name and 'Park City, UT 84060' legible past the bar. So on this filing donor_city/donor_state are populated on exactly the two rows where the county left a city visible and are honestly blank on the other four - blank BECAUSE REDACTED, not because the filer left them empty, and that distinction is carried on each row. Street names visible past a bar are discarded at read time as always; nothing but city and state is written here. THE 2026 FORM prints DATE | NAME OF CONTRIBUTOR | ADDRESS | AMOUNT with no Zip Code column (same as 27197), and unlike 27197 this filer DID date every row (m/d/26 throughout). THE TWO SCHEDULES MIRROR EACH OTHER: the candidate's own 843.42 contribution on 1/7/26 is the County Clerk filing fee paid the same day; Jay Woolstenhulme's 200.21 on 3/29/26 is the Wix.com website charge of that date; his 191.61 on 3/31/26 is the Staples flier bill of that date. The family paid vendors directly and booked the payments as contributions, so the same three figures appear on both pages - a useful cross-check, and a caution to anyone reading the totals as independent. GEOMETRY: p3 is MEASURED (bands 4-7, crop-verified; the stored boxes are narrow, about 23% of page width, because only two vertical rules survive detection on that page - the vertical extent is exact). p2 is DECLARED: the black redaction bars destroy the row rules across the address column and rowbands returns 4.5-high merged blocks over the data rows, so the frame (y0 26.39, pitch 1.80) is fitted to the page's OWN surviving rules below the redacted block, where the detected rules run 35.37, 36.56(sub-rule), 38.49, 40.77, 42.60, 44.35, 46.17, 47.97 - a uniform 1.80 pitch that extrapolates back to the table top at 26.39 and lands every predicted rule within 0.05. Bands 2 and 7 were crop-verified to frame the first and last donor rows.
